Leslie: I wanted to mention that on the Bellview Biltmore hotel project approx $10 millioin in historic tax credits 
are generated. They are sold for 92 cents on the dollar to high net worth individuals or corpoarations. Fed. tax 
law permits a buyer to take a full dollar off of their taxable income even though they paid a discounted amount 
on the dollar. Your company accountant is probably aware of this program. The sale of these tax credits creates 
cash which becomes equity into the project. 
Buying discounted historic tax credits is not a risk proposition; directly investing in a project always has some 
degree of risk. Please show this to your com an accountant to see if he/she would be interested in this purchase

Private Jet Group is composed of three companies: Private Jet Management Group. Inc. (PJM). Private Jet Commercial Group. Inc. (PJC). and Private Jet Services 
Group. Inc. (PJS). PJM acts as exclusive marketing and booking agent for licensed Part 135 air carriers holding FAA Certificates which operate all flights available 
through PJM. PJM does not own. lease or operate aircraft. PJC acts as marketing and booking agent for USA Jet Aides Inc.. a bcensed Part 121 air earner holding 
FAA Certificate Number Y2PA150Y and operating all flights available through PJC. PJC does not own. lease or operate aircraft. PJS is an air charter broker serving 
discerning corporate clients and leisure travelers through the use of VIP and coach configured airliners as well as small. midsize. and large cabin executive jets fa 
meetings. top-tier incentive programs. lye entertainment tourng. customer appreciation events and luxury travel. 
PJS mantains a repeat-client rate in excess of 90% and this strong client loyalty is the best idicator of PJS's specialization. pricing. and performance. PJS acts as 
agent for its clients in negotiating and facilitating transportation with licensed air carriers. PJS does not own. lease or operate aircraft and has no affiliation with any 
carrier except that PJS's sister companies. PJM and PJC. act as agents for carriers as set forth above. Transportation booked through PJS to be furnished by a PJM or 
PJC Air Carrier will be arranged through the interaction of PJS on behalf of its client and PJM or PJC respectively on behalf of the carrier.

pleased to be taking part in this impactful initiative." 
With a mission dear to the heart of Jason and Haley Binn, the Women's International Zionist Organization 
(WIZO) will be among the charities benefiting from The Global Party's philanthropic efforts. 
"Especially with the unique timing of Israel being at the fore-front of international discussions, I am happy 
to be involved with this truly global fundraising event that will garner much attention and benefits WIZO, 
an organization so dear to my heart," added Haley Binn.

Party will be held for 24 hours at more than 80 of the world's finest venues from Mumbai to New York and

About Women's International Zionist Organization (WIZO) 
WIZO, founded in 1920, is an international organization of volunteers working in 52 countries to improve 
the lives of women and children living in Israel. In a united effort, WIZO's members work to support and 
fund over 800 WIZO projects in Israel. WIZO institutions include childcare centers, schools, and shelters 
for battered women and girls in distress, golden age clubs and a residential home for the elderly. 
WIZO USA is accredited as a non-profit organization throughout the United States. Since 1959, WIZO is 
recognized by the United Nations as a non-governmental organization with consultative status in ECOSOC

SPA & FITNESS 
We invite all guests at The Charles Hotel to visit Wellbridge Athletic Club and Corbu 
Salon and Spa (opening Spring 2011) during their stay. Both facilities are adjacent to 
the hotel. 
Whether you are looking for top-of-the-line equipment in a state-of-the-art facility, or 
just a place to relax and release, you will be fully accommodated at The Charles Hotel.

ACTIVITIES & SPECIALS 
RThe Charles Hotel 
With a variety of distinct neighborhoods, including Harvard Square, Boston offers something 
for everyone. It is a truly walkable city — visitors can stroll the historic streets of Beacon Hill. 
catch a Red Sox game at Fenway Park, or enjoy a first-class shopping experience along 
Newbury Street. 
Following is a list of activities & specials you can enjoy during your stay. 
The Charles Hotel 
• Don't miss Friday at the Charles Square Farmers Market! Each Friday and Sunday, 
New England farms, such as Kimball Fruit Farm and Grateful Farm, line up to offer 
you everything from artisan cheeses to poultry to homemade pies. The market 
begins at 12 noon and goes until 6 pm. Be the first to pick out a tasty snack for 
the day!
